title: Bathe in Beauty
coreMove: Beauty steadies the soul when you make room for it on purpose: let a tree, poem, song, or quiet street pull you out of yourself and back to life.

exampleSpecs.stakes: urgent messages are crowding out a needed pause
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a routine is interrupted and the pause becomes the practice

exampleSpecs.stakes: a small quiet moment can be valued without being turned into output
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: one close lived detail teaches without a decision

exampleSpecs.stakes: beauty was used as decoration for hurry
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: open after failure and locate the decisive misstep

exampleSpecs.stakes: a calming ritual is turning into one more demand
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist notices her own error mid-stream

exampleSpecs.stakes: the practice needs a written form that resists measurement
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the written artifact carries the action

exampleSpecs.stakes: the same delay can tighten or widen attention
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two named people face the same situation with opposite approaches
